items.source: Default is "classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml".
items.translation: 默认值为"classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml"。

items.source: Set the ManagedClassNameFilter to apply on entity classes discovered using classpath scanning.
items.translation: 将 `ManagedClassNameFilter` 设置为应用于通过类路径扫描发现的实体类。

items.source: Set the PersistenceManagedTypes to use to build the list of managed types for the default persistence unit, as an alternative to entity scanning.
items.translation: 将 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 设置为构建默认持久化单元托管类型列表的方式，作为实体扫描的替代方案。

items.source: persistenceUnitName - the name of the desired persistence unit
items.translation: - 所需持久化单元的名称

items.source: the PersistenceUnitInfo (never null)
items.translation: PersistenceUnitInfo（永远不为null）

items.source: Builds a persistence unit based on the state of a PersistenceManagedTypes, typically built using a PersistenceManagedTypesScanner.
items.translation: 根据 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 的状态构建持久化单元，通常使用 `PersistenceManagedTypesScanner` 进行构建。

items.source: Note: There may be limitations in comparison to regular JPA scanning. In particular, JPA providers may pick up annotated packages for provider-specific annotations only when driven by persistence.xml. As of 4.1, Spring's scan can detect annotated packages as well if supported by the given JpaVendorAdapter (for example, for Hibernate).
items.translation: 注意：与常规 JPA 扫描相比，可能存在一些限制。 特别是，当由 persistence.xml 驱动时，JPA 提供者可能仅拾取针对特定提供者的注解包。从 4.1 版本开始，如果给定的 JpaVendorAdapter（例如 Hibernate）支持，Spring 的扫描也可以检测这些已注解的包。

items.source: If no explicit mapping resources have been specified in addition to these packages, this manager looks for a default META-INF/orm.xml file in the classpath, registering it as a mapping resource for the default unit if the mapping file is not co-located with a persistence.xml file (in which case we assume it is only meant to be used with the persistence units defined there, like in standard JPA).
items.translation: 如果除了这些包之外没有显式指定任何mapping resources，该管理器将在类路径中查找默认的META-INF/orm.xml文件。如果该映射文件不与persistence.xml文件共存（在这种情况下，我们假设它仅用于其中定义的持久化单元，就像标准 JPA 一样），则将其注册为默认单元的映射资源。

items.source: If no explicit mapping resources have been specified next to packages to scan, this manager looks for a default META-INF/orm.xml file in the classpath, registering it as a mapping resource for the default unit if the mapping file is not co-located with a persistence.xml file (in which case we assume it is only meant to be used with the persistence units defined there, like in standard JPA).
items.translation: 如果未显式指定扫描包的映射资源，此管理器将在类路径中查找默认的META-INF/orm.xml文件。如果该映射文件不与persistence.xml文件共存（在这种情况下，我们假设它仅用于其中定义的持久化单元，就像标准 JPA 一样），则将其注册为默认单元的映射资源。

items.source: Default is false. May be overridden to return true, for example if postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo(MutablePersistenceUnitInfo) is able to handle that case.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`。可将其覆盖为返回 `true`，例如如果 postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo(MutablePersistenceUnitInfo) 能够处理该情况。

items.source: Such package scanning defines a "default persistence unit" in Spring, which may live next to regularly defined units originating from persistence.xml. Its name is determined by setDefaultPersistenceUnitName(String): by default, it's simply "default".
items.translation: 此类包扫描在 Spring 中定义了一个“默认持久化单元”，它可能位于由 `persistence.xml` 定义的常规单元旁边。其名称由 setDefaultPersistenceUnitName(String) 确定：默认情况下，该名称仅为 "default"。

items.source: Default is none. Specify packages to search for autodetection of your entity classes in the classpath. This is analogous to Spring's component-scan feature (ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner).
items.translation: 默认值为 none。指定要在类路径中搜索以自动检测实体类的包。这类似于 Spring 的 component-scan 功能（ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner）。

items.source: Consider setting a PersistenceManagedTypes instead that allows the scanning logic to be optimized by AOT processing.
items.translation: 考虑设置一个 `PersistenceManagedTypes`，以允许通过 AOT 处理优化扫描逻辑。

items.source: This can be used in postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo(MutablePersistenceUnitInfo) implementations, detecting existing persistence units of the same name and potentially merging them.
items.translation: 这可以在 `postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo(MutablePersistenceUnitInfo)` 实现中使用，用于检测具有相同名称的现有持久化单元并可能将它们合并。

items.source: Supports standard JPA scanning for persistence.xml files, with configurable file locations, JDBC DataSource lookup and load-time weaving.
items.translation: 支持对 `persistence.xml` 文件进行标准的 JPA 扫描，并支持配置文件位置、JDBC DataSource 查找以及加载时织入。

items.source: The default XML file location is classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml, scanning for all matching files in the classpath (as defined in the JPA specification). DataSource names are by default interpreted as JNDI names, and no load time weaving is available (which requires weaving to be turned off in the persistence provider).
items.translation: 默认 XML 文件位置为 `classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml`，将在类路径中扫描所有匹配的文件（如 JPA 规范中所定义）。数据源名称默认被解释为 JNDI 名称，且不可用加载时织入功能（这需要在持久化提供者中关闭织入）。

items.source: Primarily applied to a scanned persistence unit without persistence.xml. Also applicable to selecting a default unit from several persistence units available.
items.translation: 主要应用于没有 `<persistence.xml>` 的扫描持久化单元。也适用于从多个可用的持久化单元中选择默认单元。

items.source: The specified Map needs to define data source names for specific DataSource objects, matching the data source names used in persistence.xml. If not specified, data source names will be resolved as JNDI names instead (as defined by standard JPA).
items.translation: 指定的 Map 需要为特定的 DataSource 对象定义数据源名称，这些名称必须与 `persistence.xml` 中使用的数据源名称相匹配。如果未指定，则数据源名称将作为 JNDI 名称进行解析（按照标准 JPA 的定义）。

items.source: Alternatively, consider passing in a map from names to DataSource instances via the "dataSources" property. If the persistence.xml file does not define DataSource names at all, specify a default DataSource via the "defaultDataSource" property.
items.translation: 或者，考虑通过"dataSources"属性传递一个从名称到 DataSource 实例的映射。如果<persistence.xml>文件根本没有定义 DataSource 名称，则通过"defaultDataSource"属性指定默认 DataSource。

items.source: Such post-processors can, for example, register further entity classes and jar files, in addition to the metadata read from persistence.xml.
items.translation: 此类后处理器可以注册额外的实体类和 jar 文件，除了从 `persistence.xml` 读取的元数据之外。

items.source: In terms of Spring-provided weaving options, the most important ones are InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver, which requires a Spring-specific (but very general) VM agent specified on JVM startup, and ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver, which interacts with an underlying ClassLoader based on specific extended methods being available on it (for example, interacting with Spring's TomcatInstrumentableClassLoader). Consider using the context:load-time-weaver XML tag for creating such a shared LoadTimeWeaver (autodetecting the environment by default).
items.translation: 在 Spring 提供的织入选项中，最重要的是 `InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver`（需要在 JVM 启动时指定一个 Spring 专用的、但非常通用的 VM agent）和 `ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver`（它与底层的 ClassLoader 交互，基于其上可用的特定扩展方法，例如与 Spring 的 `TomcatInstrumentableClassLoader` 交互）。建议使用 `context:load-time-weaver` XML 标签来创建此类共享的 LoadTimeWeaver（默认自动检测环境）。

items.source:
Default is JndiDataSourceLookup, which resolves DataSource names as
JNDI names (as defined by standard JPA). Specify a BeanFactoryDataSourceLookup
instance if you want DataSource names to be resolved against Spring bean names.
items.translation: 默认值为 `JndiDataSourceLookup`，它将数据源名称解析为 JNDI 名称（按标准 JPA 定义）。如果您希望将数据源名称解析为 Spring bean 名称，请指定一个 `BeanFactoryDataSourceLookup` 实例。

items.source:
In JPA speak, a DataSource passed in here will be uses as "nonJtaDataSource"
on the PersistenceUnitInfo passed to the PersistenceProvider, provided that
none has been registered before.
items.translation: 在 JPA 术语中，如果在此处传入的 DataSource 之前未注册过任何数据源，它将被用作传递给 PersistenceProvider 的 PersistenceUnitInfo 中的"nonJtaDataSource"。

items.source:
In JPA speak, a DataSource passed in here will be uses as "jtaDataSource"
on the PersistenceUnitInfo passed to the PersistenceProvider, provided that
none has been registered before.
items.translation: 在 JPA 术语中，此处传入的 DataSource 将作为传递给 PersistenceProvider 的 PersistenceUnitInfo 中的"jtaDataSource"使用，前提是此前未注册过该数据源。

items.source:
It is not required to specify a LoadTimeWeaver: Most providers will be able
to provide a subset of their functionality without class instrumentation as well,
or operate with their own VM agent specified on JVM startup. Furthermore,
DefaultPersistenceUnitManager falls back to an InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver
if Spring's agent-based instrumentation is available at runtime.
items.translation: 无需指定 LoadTimeWeaver：大多数提供者能够在没有类增强的情况下提供其功能子集，或者在 JVM 启动时通过自己的 VM agent 运行。此外，如果运行时可用 Spring 的基于代理的增强功能，DefaultPersistenceUnitManager 将回退到 InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver。

items.source:
PersistenceUnitInfos cannot be obtained before this preparation
method has been invoked.
items.translation: 在调用此准备方法之前，无法获取 PersistenceUnitInfos。

items.source:
The default implementation delegates to all registered PersistenceUnitPostProcessors.
It is usually preferable to register further entity classes, jar files etc there
rather than in a subclass of this manager, to be able to reuse the post-processors.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给所有已注册的 PersistenceUnitPostProcessors。通常，最好在那里注册更多的实体类、jar 文件等，而不是在此管理器的子类中注册，以便能够重用这些后置处理器。

items.translation: 返回此管理器缓存中已处理的持久化单元指定的MutablePersistenceUnitInfo，并将其保留在缓存中（即

items.source: Hook method allowing subclasses to customize each MutablePersistenceUnitInfo.
items.translation: 钩子方法，允许子类自定义每个MutablePersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source: Set a JPA 3.2 PersistenceConfiguration to apply to the default persistence unit. The contained configuration will be merged with the common settings specified on this DefaultPersistenceUnitManager.
items.translation: 设置一个适用于默认持久化单元的 JPA 3.2 `PersistenceConfiguration`。其中包含的配置将与在此 `DefaultPersistenceUnitManager` 上指定的通用设置进行合并。

items.source: Default location of the persistence.xml file: "classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml".
items.translation: 默认位置为 persistence.xml 文件："classpath*:META-INF/persistence.xml"。

items.source: Return the JDBC DataSourceLookup that provides DataSources for the persistence provider, resolving data source names in persistence.xml against Spring-managed DataSource instances.
items.translation: 返回用于为持久化提供者提供数据源的 JDBC DataSourceLookup，该 Lookup 会在 `persistence.xml` 中解析数据源名称，并将其映射到由 Spring 管理的数据源实例。

items.source: Return the JDBC DataSource that the JPA persistence provider is supposed to use for accessing the database if none has been specified in persistence.xml.
items.translation: 如果未在 `persistence.xml` 中指定，返回 JPA 持久性提供者用于访问数据库的 JDBC DataSource。

items.source: Return the JTA-aware DataSource that the JPA persistence provider is supposed to use for accessing the database if none has been specified in persistence.xml.
items.translation: 如果未在 `persistence.xml` 中指定，返回 JPA 持久化提供者用于访问数据库的 JTA 感知 DataSource。

items.source: Specify the JDBC DataSource that the JPA persistence provider is supposed to use for accessing the database if none has been specified in persistence.xml.
items.translation: 如果未在 `persistence.xml` 中指定，请指定 JPA 持久性提供者用于访问数据库的 JDBC DataSource。

items.source: Specify the JPA 2.0 shared cache mode for all of this manager's persistence units, overriding any value in persistence.xml if set.
items.translation: 指定此管理器所有持久化单元的 JPA 2.0 共享缓存模式，如果已设置，则覆盖 `persistence.xml` 中的任何值。

items.source: Specify the JPA 2.0 validation mode for all of this manager's persistence units, overriding any value in persistence.xml if set.
items.translation: 指定此管理器所有持久化单元的 JPA 2.0 验证模式，如果已设置，则覆盖 `persistence.xml` 中的任何值。

items.source: Default persistence unit name.
items.translation: 默认持久化单元名称。

items.source:
Default location for the persistence unit root URL:
"classpath:", indicating the root of the classpath.
items.translation: 持久单元根 URL 的默认位置："classpath:"，表示类路径的根目录。

items.source:
Return the Spring LoadTimeWeaver to use for class instrumentation according
to the JPA class transformer contract.
items.translation: 根据 JPA 类转换器合约，返回用于类仪器化的 Spring LoadTimeWeaver。

items.source:
Return the PersistenceUnitPostProcessors to be applied to each
PersistenceUnitInfo that has been parsed by this manager.
items.translation: 返回此管理器已解析的每个 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 所应用的 `PersistenceUnitPostProcessors`。

items.source: Obtain the default PersistenceUnitInfo from this manager.
items.translation: 从此管理器获取默认的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source: Obtain the specified PersistenceUnitInfo from this manager.
items.translation: 从此管理器获取指定的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.translation: `setLoadTimeWeaver` 接口 `LoadTimeWeaverAware` 中

items.translation: `obtainDefaultPersistenceUnitInfo` 接口 `PersistenceUnitManager`

items.translation: `obtainPersistenceUnitInfo` 接口 `PersistenceUnitManager` 中

items.source: persistenceXmlLocations - an array of Spring resource Strings identifying the location of the persistence.xml files to read
items.translation: persistenceXmlLocations - 一个包含 Spring 资源字符串的数组，用于标识要读取的 persistence.xml 文件的位置。

items.source: pui - the chosen persistence unit configuration, as read from persistence.xml. Passed in as MutablePersistenceUnitInfo.
items.translation: - 从 persistence.xml 读取的选定持久化单元配置。以 MutablePersistenceUnitInfo 形式传入。

items.source: the PersistenceUnitInfo in mutable form, or null if not available
items.translation: 可变形式的 PersistenceUnitInfo，或如果不可用则为null

items.source: Note that specifying an empty array/list here suppresses the default META-INF/orm.xml check. On the other hand, explicitly specifying META-INF/orm.xml here will register that file even if it happens to be co-located with a persistence.xml file.
items.translation: 请注意，在此处指定空数组/列表会抑制默认的 `META-INF/orm.xml` 检查。另一方面，如果此处显式指定 `META-INF/orm.xml`，即使该文件与 `persistence.xml 文件共存，也会注册该文件。

items.source: This might be a ResourcePatternResolver, which can be checked through instanceof ResourcePatternResolver. See also the ResourcePatternUtils.getResourcePatternResolver method.
items.translation: 这可能是一个 `ResourcePatternResolver`，可以通过 `instanceof ResourcePatternResolver` 进行检查。另请参阅 `ResourcePatternUtils.getResourcePatternResolver` 方法。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method. Invoked before ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但早于初始化回调（如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之前被调用。在 `ApplicationContextAware` 的 `setApplicationContext` 之前被调用。
注意，映射资源必须相对于类路径根目录，例如"META-INF/mappings.xml"或"com/mycompany/repository/mappings.xml"，以便可以通过 `ClassLoader.getResource` 加载它们。

items.source:
Default is "classpath:", that is, the root of the current classpath
(nearest root directory). To be overridden if unit-specific resolution
does not work and the classpath root is not appropriate either.
items.translation: 默认值为"classpath:"，即当前类路径的根目录（最近的根目录）。如果无法通过针对特定单元的解析进行覆盖，且类路径根目录也不合适时，则使用此值。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：InitializingBean

items.source: Specify one or more mapping resources (equivalent to <mapping-file> entries in persistence.xml) for the default persistence unit.
items.translation: 为默认持久化单元指定一个或多个映射资源（相当于`persistence.xml` 中的 `<mapping-file>` 条目）。

items.source: Prepare the PersistenceUnitInfos according to the configuration of this manager: scanning for persistence.xml files, parsing all matching files, configuring and post-processing them.
items.translation: 根据此管理器的配置准备 PersistenceUnitInfos：扫描 `persistence.xml` 文件，解析所有匹配的文件，并对它们进行配置和后处理。

items.source: Specify the JDBC DataSourceLookup that provides DataSources for the persistence provider, resolving data source names in persistence.xml against Spring-managed DataSource instances.
items.translation: 指定用于为持久化提供者提供 DataSource 的 JDBC DataSourceLookup，该 Lookup 将 `persistence.xml` 中的数据源名称解析为 Spring 管理的 DataSource 实例。

items.source: Specify the JDBC DataSources that the JPA persistence provider is supposed to use for accessing the database, resolving data source names in persistence.xml against Spring-managed DataSources.
items.translation: 指定 JPA 持久化提供者用于访问数据库的 JDBC DataSource，通过在 `persistence.xml` 中解析数据源名称以匹配 Spring 管理的 DataSource。

items.source: Set whether to use Spring-based scanning for entity classes in the classpath instead of using JPA's standard scanning of jar files with persistence.xml markers in them.
items.translation: 设置是否在类路径中使用基于 Spring 的实体类扫描，而不是使用 JPA 对包含 `persistence.xml` 标记的 jar 文件的标准扫描。

items.source: Set a JPA 3.2 PersistenceConfiguration to apply to the default persistence unit.
items.translation: 设置一个适用于默认持久化单元的 JPA 3.2 `PersistenceConfiguration`。

items.source: Specify the location of the persistence.xml files to load.
items.translation: 指定要加载的 `persistence.xml` 文件的位置。

items.source: Specify multiple locations of persistence.xml files to load.
items.translation: 指定多个要加载的 `persistence.xml` 文件位置。

items.source: Return whether an override of a same-named persistence unit is allowed.
items.translation: 返回是否允许覆盖同名的持久化单元。

items.source: Specify the name of the default persistence unit, if any.
items.translation: 指定默认持久化单元的名称（如果有）。

items.source:
Set the default persistence unit root location, to be applied
if no unit-specific persistence unit root could be determined.
items.translation: 设置默认持久化单元根目录位置，在无法确定特定单元的持久化单元根目录时应用。

items.source:
Specify the Spring LoadTimeWeaver to use for class instrumentation according
to the JPA class transformer contract.
items.translation: 根据 JPA 类转换器合同，指定用于类仪器化的 Spring LoadTimeWeaver。

items.source:
Set the PersistenceUnitPostProcessors to be applied to each
PersistenceUnitInfo that has been parsed by this manager.
items.translation: 将已解析的每个 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 所应用的 `PersistenceUnitPostProcessors` 设置为此管理器。

items.translation: 设置该对象运行的资源加载器。
